title: The Amber Cliff
text: A cliff of amber glows like dim stars in the grey light. Things are caught inside it, hanging where they died: insects, birds, a fox in mid-leap. Further in, a man, his mouth open, his hand pressed flat against the inside as if he is still trying to get out.

options.label: Harvest the golden amber from the cliffside, and forsake the man.

outcomes.text: It comes away in warm, glowing chunks, worth their weight in Essence. Nobody looks too closely at what is inside them.

options.label: The strongest cuts the man free.

outcomes.text: He draws a breath and weeps with relief. He pays you in coin no one has minted for a thousand years.
He breathes, and stretches, and his form twists. What stands before you is no man.

options.label: The wisest studies the creatures in the amber, hoping to glean some insight from what is trapped within.

outcomes.text: Ancient creatures, long since vanished from the world, and a few that never should have been in it, peer out from inside the amber. They are better left undisturbed.
